cards.audioText: Right heading 330, descending to 3000 feet, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 右转航向330，下降到3000英尺，可以盲降进近，跑道36右。

cards.audioText: Cleared to exit the hold, fly direct to ML. Contact Approach on 128.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以离开等待，直飞ML。联系进近128.35，

cards.audioText: After passing SY VOR, leave the hold on heading 250, cleared for VOR approach Runway 06.
cards.audioTextZh: 过SYVOR台后，离开等待，航向250，可以VOR进近，跑道06号。

cards.audioText: Cleared to LHR, hold at LHR as published. Maintain 8000 feet.Expect further clearance at 18.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以飞往LHR，并按公布的航图在LHR等待。保持高度8000英尺，预计进一步许可时间18。

cards.audioText: Cleared to destination via ZAM, flight planned route, D03 Departure,cruising level 230, squawk 3763.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以经由ZAM飞往目的地，按照计划航路，D-03号标准仪表离场，巡航高度层230，应答机3763。

cards.audioText: Recleared to destination via ZF01 Departure, Runway 36R, rest of clearance unchanged.
cards.audioTextZh: 重新允许经由ZF-01号标准离场程序飞往目的地，跑道36R，其余许可不变。

cards.audioText: Cleared to destination, BK02 RNAV Departure, initially 3000 feet,departure frequency 125.4, squawk 3311.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以到目的地机场，BK02号RNAV离场，起始高度3000英尺，离场频率125.4，应答机编码3311。

cards.audioText: Behind Boeing747 passing left to right, taxi to holding point A1 Runway 24.
cards.audioTextZh: 后面的波音747从左向右通过后，滑行至24号跑道等待点A1。

cards.audioText: Thicker patches of fog exist further along the runway. RVR significantly reduced.
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道后端雾会变浓。跑道视程明显变差。

cards.audioText: Your radar vector appears to be taking us to the prohibited area,confirm.
cards.audioTextZh: 雷达引导好像把我们带入了禁飞区，证实。

cards.audioText: We have traffic at our 12 o’clock, 5 miles, 500 feet below, climbing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们看到了活动飞机，在12点钟方位，5海里，低于我们500英尺，正在上升。

cards.audioText: We are too low to the surrounding terrain. Confirm we are still being radar vectored.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们高度太低，周围有地形。证实我们仍然被雷达引导。

cards.audioText: Hold over BKM VOR at FL100, inbound track 280 degrees, left hand pattern, outbound time 1 minute.
cards.audioTextZh: 在BKMVOR台等待，高度层100，向台航迹280度，左等待，背台时间1分钟。

cards.audioText: Reduce to minimum approach speed, turn right heading 230,cleared for ILS approach Runway 27.
cards.audioTextZh: 减小到最小进近速度，右转航向230，可以盲降进近，跑道27号。

cards.audioText: Climb to and maintain FL310. Maintain Mach number decimal 81 or greater until BKM VOR.
cards.audioTextZh: 上升并保持高度310。BKMVOR台前保持马赫数点81或更大。

cards.audioText: Descend to and maintain FL 270. Do not exceed Mach number decimal 79.
cards.audioTextZh: 下降并保持高度270。不要超出马赫数点79。

cards.audioText: Climb to and maintain FL290, re-cleared to track direct to BKM VOR, the rest unchanged.
cards.audioTextZh: 上升并保持高度290，重新直飞BKMVOR台，其余未变。

cards.audioText: Passing POU at 43, maintaining FL310, estimating MLT at 55,next NLD.
cards.audioTextZh: 当前位置POU，时间43分，高度310，预计MLT55分，下一位置NLD。

cards.audioText: Request clearance to enter controlled airspace northeast of BKM VOR at FL240 at time 43.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求在BKMVOR台东北方向高度240，时间43分时进入管制空域的许可。

cards.audioText: Descending to FL60, maintain VMC FL90 to FL70, report traffic in sight at FL80.
cards.audioTextZh: 下降到高度层60，高度90到高度70之间保持目视气象条件，高度80看见活动飞机报告。

cards.audioText: Cleared to destination airport via DAPRO, flight planned route,FL240, join A1 at FL240.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以按DAPRO计划航路飞往目的地机场，高度240，并在高度层240加入A1航路。

cards.audioText: Cleared to leave A1 via BKM VOR, maintain FL230 while in controlled airspace.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以经由BKMVOR台离开A1，在管制空域保持高度230。

cards.audioText: At 150W(west) contact San Francisco Radio, primary 3494,secondary 11342.
cards.audioTextZh: 在西经150度联系旧金山无线电，主高频3494，备份高频11342。

cards.audioText: All our air conditioning packs have malfunctioned. Request rapid descent to MEA .
cards.audioTextZh: 我们全部的空调组件已故障。请求快速下降到最低航路高度。

cards.audioText: We had a malfunction of one air conditioning pack. Request descent to a lower level.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有一个空调组件故障。请求下降到较低高度。

cards.audioText: We have lost electrical power to the cabin air compressor. Request immediate descent to 10,000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的客舱空气压缩机失去电源。请求立即下降到10000英尺。

cards.audioText: We have unusual smell from air conditioning packs. Request stop climb at 7000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 空调组件出现异常气味。请求在7000英尺，停止爬升。

cards.audioText: Request descent rate less than 500 feet per minute due to unpressurized cabin.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于客舱失压，请求下降率小于每分钟500英尺。

cards.audioText: We have an avionics ventilation problem. The skin heat-exchangers and blower fan have failed.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的电子通风有问题。蒙皮热交换器和吹风扇都故障了。

cards.audioText: We have a navigation map shift, unable to perform the RNAV approach. Request radar vectors.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有导航地图漂移，无法飞RNAV进近。申请雷达引导。

cards.audioText: Inertial reference system has failed. We are navigating on raw data. Request conventional approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 惯导失效了，我们正在使用原始导航，申请传统进近。

cards.audioText: The ILS signal seems to be very unstable. Did any other pilot report a similar situation?
cards.audioTextZh: 盲降信号不稳定，其他飞行员报告过类似情况吗？

cards.audioText: The ILS signal was unstable. Request approach to another runway or request another type of approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 盲降信号不稳定。申请换一条跑道进近，或申请另一种进近方式。

cards.audioText: The DME indication is not correct. Confirm the DME is still in service.
cards.audioTextZh: DME显示不对。证实DME还在运行中。

cards.audioText: We need a few minutes to reprogram the flight management computers. Request radar vectors.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们需要几分钟重新输程序到飞行管理计算机，申请雷达引导。

cards.audioText: We need to reconfigure the flight management computers for approach. Request holding instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们需要为进近重新设置飞行管理计算机，申请等待指令。

cards.audioText: We are now flying with basic navigation due to systems failure. Request radar vectors.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于系统故障，我们现在使用基本导航飞行。申请雷达引导。

cards.audioText: We are not qualified for CAT IIIB approach and auto-land. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们不具备IIIB类进近和自动着陆资格。请求改航。

cards.audioText: Our VHF number One receiver has failed. We are no longer monitoring 121.5.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们第一部甚高频接收机失效，我们不再监听121.5。

cards.audioText: All of our VHF transmitters have failed, now transmitting on HF radio. Please respond.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们所有甚高频发射机都失效了，现在高频无线电发报，请回复。

cards.audioText: One of our transformers has failed. I’ll let you know if a diversion is required.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们一个变压整流器故障了。如果需要备降我会第一时间告诉你。

cards.audioText: We are operating with only the emergency generator. Request track direct to final, Runway 26.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们能够使用的只有紧急发电机。申请直飞五边，跑道26号。

cards.audioText: We are flying with batteries only. Is there any airport available within 25 minutes of flying?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们仅依靠电瓶飞行。有没有25分钟之内能够飞到的可用机场？

cards.audioText: If there is no airport within 100 miles, we have to make a forced landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 如果100海里范围内没有机场，我们必须迫降。

cards.audioText: We have cut off the electrical system to the cabin and the onboard fire is under control.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已经切断了到客舱的电气系统，机上火情得到了控制。

cards.audioText: We had an electrical fire from the galley, now extinguished. Request return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有厨房电气火警，现在已经熄灭。请求返场着陆。

cards.audioText: There was a fire from the avionics bay. Request radar vectors for final.
cards.audioTextZh: 电子设备舱有火警。请求雷达引导到五边。

cards.audioText: We cannot extinguish the engine fire. Request priority landing and emergency services on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们不能熄灭发动机火情。申请优先落地和到场时的紧急服务。

cards.audioText: A passenger ignited the lavatory waste bin. Advise the airport police to await our arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名旅客点燃了盥洗室垃圾桶。告知机场警察到场来处理。

cards.audioText: We have smoke coming from our avionics bay. We are evacuating. Request fire trucks.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有烟雾来自我们的电子设备舱。我们正在紧急撤离。申请消防车。

cards.audioText: We have smoke coming from our avionics bay. We are disembarking the passengers.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有烟雾来自我们的电子设备舱，我们正在让旅客离机。

cards.audioText: We have emptied most of our fire extinguishers, but the cabin fire is still on.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已经释放了灭火瓶，但客舱火警仍然存在。

cards.audioText: Our flight control computers are not functioning well. We are having difficulty maintaining level flight, unable RVSM.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们飞行操作计算机工作不太理想，我们保持平飞有些困难，不能在RVSM空域飞行。

cards.audioText: The aircraft has a tendency to roll to the right. I need additional airspace to maneuver.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机有向右横滚的趋势，我需要更多的的空域来机动。

cards.audioText: Request high speed approach. Part of our flight control surfaces have separated from the wing.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求大速度进近。部分飞机操作面与机翼分离。

cards.audioText: Request vectors for long final. We are controlling the airplane with mechanical backup.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求雷达引导到长五边。我们正用机械备用设备操作飞机。

cards.audioText: We have a problem with yaw damping. The aircraft is oscillating severely. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们偏航阻尼出现问题，飞机摇摆很严重，申请备降。

cards.audioText: We have a problem with fuel temperature. Request holding position on the taxiway.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的燃油温度有问题。请求滑行道上原地等待。

cards.audioText: We might have a fuel leak near the wing root. Request fire trucks on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 翼根可能存在漏油，申请消防车到场。

cards.audioText: We are evacuating. Advise emergency personnel that fuel odors are still present in the cabin.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们正在紧急撤离。请告诉地面人员机上仍然有燃油味道。

cards.audioText: We are too heavy for landing. Request fuel-dump at the fuel dumping area.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们返场落地重量会太重。申请去放油区域放油。

cards.audioText: We need about 18 minutes to jettison fuel before coming in for the approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们在进近前需要大概18分钟放油。

cards.audioText: We cannot shut off the fuel dump valve. Request radar vectors for short final, Runway 17.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们无法关断放油活门，申请雷达引导到短五边，跑道17。

cards.audioText: We are indicating fuel filter clog. Request descent and to maintain high speed.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们显示有燃油过滤阻塞，申请下降并保持大速度。

cards.audioText: We are near the freezing temperature of jet fuel. Request descent to FL 390.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们接近燃油的冰点温度，申请下降到高度390。

cards.audioText: Request the longest runway and vectors for a wide downwind due to hydraulic failure.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于液压失效，请求最长的跑道和雷达引导到宽的三边。

cards.audioText: We still have only one hydraulic system. Request the longest runway for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们仍然有一套液压系统。申请最长的跑道着陆。

cards.audioText: Our left engine anti-ice system has failed. Request immediate climb to leave the icing area.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的左发防冰系统故障，申请立即上升来脱离结冰区域。

cards.audioText: We must descend immediately to exit icing conditions. Our right engine bleed air has failed.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们必须立即下降脱离结冰条件。我们的右发引气已失效。

cards.audioText: Our pitot static heating system has failed. We might have an altitude error.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们皮托管静压口加温系统故障了，我们可能有高度误差。

cards.audioText: We have an error in our airspeed. Request to climb to minimum safe altitude.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的空速有误差。申请上升到最低安全高度以上。

cards.audioText: We have master warning lights in the cockpit. Request landing at the nearest suitable airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的驾驶舱主警告灯亮了。申请就近合适机场着陆。

cards.audioText: We have a master caution. I will notify you if a diversion is required.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有一个主警告灯亮了。如需备降，我将告知。

cards.audioText: Some of our instruments are not indicating correctly. Request level off to perform checklist.
cards.audioTextZh: 一些仪表不能正确显示，申请改平飞执行检查单。

cards.audioText: Two of our display units have failed. We are no longer RNP qualified. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的两个显示屏故障。我们不再具备RNP资格。申请备降。

cards.audioText: We made the go around due to map drift on our navigation display.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们复飞是因为导航显示上地图漂移。

cards.audioText: We have autopilot disconnection. We are no longer RVSM qualified. Request leaving RVSM airspace.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们自动驾驶脱开了，我们不再符合RVSM资质，申请离开RVSM空域。

cards.audioText: Request to climb to minimum safe altitude due to malfunction of navigation computers.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于导航计算机故障，申请爬升到最低安全高度。

cards.audioText: We have conflicting traffic at one o’clock, 6 miles, descending. Request heading 130 for avoidance.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们显示冲突飞机在我们1点钟方位，6海里处，正在下降。申请航向130来避开。

cards.audioText: We have conflicting traffic at eleven o’clock, 8 miles, climbing. Request vectors for avoidance.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们显示冲突飞机在我们11点钟方位，8海里处，正在上升。申请雷达引导来避开。

cards.audioText: Traffic at our twelve o’clock, 10 miles, climbing. Should we expedite our descent to cross altitudes?
cards.audioTextZh: 冲突飞机在我们12点钟方位，10海里处，正在上升。我们应该加速下降穿越高度吗？

cards.audioText: We are having abnormal engine indications. Request to reduce speed to 250 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们显示不正常的发动机参数。申请调速到250节。

cards.audioText: Our oil pressure reading is lower than normal. Request hold at present position.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们滑油压力读数比正常要低。请求在当前位置等待。

cards.audioText: The oil temperature is higher than normal. We are monitoring other engine parameters.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们滑油温度比正常的要高。我们正在监控其他发动机参数。

cards.audioText: We are holding at present position. It appears one of the over-wing exits has unlocked.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们在原地等待。好像机翼上方的一个出口松锁。

cards.audioText: Our brakes have seized. The tyres might burst during touchdown. Request fire trucks on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的刹车卡死了。可能接地时轮胎会爆胎。申请消防车到场。

cards.audioText: We have exhausted all options. We will land without the nose gear fully locked.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们用尽了所有选项。现在只能够尝试没有前起落架完全锁住的情况下落地。

cards.audioText: The tyres are deflated. We will have to hold at present position for maintenance inspection.
cards.audioTextZh: 轮胎瘪了，我们需要原地等待机务来做检查。

cards.audioText: Our inertial reference system has failed, unable GPS approach. Request ILS or VOR approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的惯导失效了，不能够使用GPS进近。申请盲降或VOR进近。

cards.audioText: We have to recalibrate our instruments. Request to level off and maintain heading.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们需要重新校准仪表。申请改平飞并保持航向。

cards.audioText: Our airspeed is unreliable. Request climb to minimum safe altitude to perform checklist.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的空速指示不可靠。申请爬升到最低安全高度来做检查单。

cards.audioText: Our weather radar has failed and we are in IMC. Request return for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们气象雷达失效，我们仪表气象条件飞行。申请返场落地。

cards.audioText: Our weather radar has malfunctioned. What is the highest available level for cruise?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们气象雷达故障。最高可用的巡航高度是多少？

cards.audioText: Our weather radar has failed. How did the preceding aircraft deviate from the weather?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们气象雷达坏了。前机都怎么绕飞的？

cards.audioText: We do not have that route in our database. Which heading should we maintain for now？
cards.audioTextZh: 我们数据库没有这个航路。我们现在应该保持哪个航向？

cards.audioText: We have a navigation malfunction. Request diversion to a suitable airport that has less complex terrain.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有导航故障。申请备降到就近的较少复杂地形的机场。

cards.audioText: Our APU bleed air malfunctioned during engine startup. We are calling the ground staff, standby.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的APU引气在发动机开车时故障了。我们正在呼叫地面机务，请稍等。

cards.audioText: We are leaking bleed air. Request turn right heading 095 to avoid the icing area.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的引气正在泄漏。请求右转095以避开结冰区。

cards.audioText: We have an abnormal noise coming from one of our cabin doors. Request rapid descent to 5000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有一个客舱门有异常噪音。申请快速下降到5000英尺。

cards.audioText: Smoke is coming from the cabin floor. We are performing an evacuation. All slides have been deployed.
cards.audioTextZh: 有烟雾来自客舱地板。我们正在进行撤离。滑梯已经放出。

cards.audioText: We had a smoke warning from the forward cargo hold. We are evacuating.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有烟雾来自前货舱。我们正在进行撤离。

cards.audioText: We have a cargo smoke warning. We are disembarking passengers. Request fire services.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有货舱烟雾警告。我们正在让旅客下飞机。请求消防服务。

cards.audioText: The cockpit windshield has cracked. Request descent to FL220.
cards.audioTextZh: 驾驶舱风挡裂了。请求下降高度220。

cards.audioText: Neither of us can see through our windshield. Does your airport permit auto-land?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们和副驾驶都无法通过风挡看到外面。你机场允许自动着陆吗？

cards.audioText: Our engine control has malfunctioned. We cannot get much thrust. Request immediate descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的发动机控制有故障。我们不能得到较大推力。申请立即下降。

cards.audioText: We have a low oil pressure warning from engine Number Two. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的二发有滑油压力低的警告。申请备降。

cards.audioText: We have performed our procedures but engine vibration still exists. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已完成了程序但发动机抖振仍然存在。申请备降。

cards.audioText: Engine Number Three has smoke coming out of the pylon section. We are evacuating.
cards.audioTextZh: 三号发动机吊架部位出现烟雾。我们正在撤离。

cards.audioText: Our left engine has ingested FOD. We are shutting down engines and holding position.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的左发吸入了外物而损坏。我们马上关车并原地等待。

cards.audioText: We made a diversion due to reports of freezing rain at our original destination.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们备降是由于收到目的地机场冻雨报告。

cards.audioText: We are encountering clear ice. Request immediate right turn to heading 130.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们遇到了明冰。申请立即右转航向130。

cards.audioText: We cannot continue holding in icing conditions. Request descent immediately and cancel speed restrictions.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们不能在结冰条件下继续等待。请求立即下降并取消速度限制。

cards.audioText: We have a “Wind-shear Ahead” warning message. Request to delay takeoff or change to another runway.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们出现了“前方风切变”警告信息。请求延迟起飞，或换一条跑道。

cards.audioText: We have received information of a new volcanic eruption. Will it affect our route?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们收到火山喷发的一条新信息，会影响我们航路吗？

cards.audioText: We are unsure of our position due heavy fog. We are holding position.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于浓雾，我们不确定我们的位置。原地等待中。

cards.audioText: We had a rapid airspeed decay due turbulence. Request immediate descent to FL390.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的空速由于颠簸快速衰减。申请立即下降到高度390。

cards.audioText: I apologize for the level bust, but we needed the altitude loss to recover from wind-shear.
cards.audioTextZh: 很抱歉偏离指定高度了，但我们需要损失高度来改出风切变。

cards.audioText: The thunderstorms will last for about 40 minutes according to the weather update. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 根据天气更新情况，雷暴将持续约40分钟。申请备降。

cards.audioText: We made the go-around because strong convective currents on short final made our approach unstable.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们复飞的原因是因为短五边很强的对流气流使进近不稳定。

cards.audioText: We were struck by hail. Our airframe is severely damaged. Request emergency services.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们被冰雹击中了。我们的机身严重受损。申请紧急服务。

cards.audioText: Request to cancel our approach. The runway is not long enough and there are water patches.
cards.audioTextZh: 申请取消进近。跑道不够长，还有部分积水。

cards.audioText: Request holding instructions. We’ll attempt another approach when the rain showers become lighter.
cards.audioTextZh: 申请等待指令。阵雨变小的时候我们再重新进近。

cards.audioText: We have observed blowing sand in the vicinity of the airport. How long will this last?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已观察到在机场邻近地区有吹沙，持续多长时间呢？

cards.audioText: Runway is covered with patches of ice. Braking action is medium to poor.
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道被大片结冰覆盖。刹车效应中等偏差。

cards.audioText: A Pilot overflying reported seeing virga above the runways. Request to terminate our approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞越的一名飞行员报告在跑道上空看见了雨幡。申请终止进近。

cards.audioText: Lining up Runway 35. Runway lights are too bright. Request to dim the runway lights.
cards.audioTextZh: 进跑道35。跑道灯太亮。申请调暗跑道灯。

cards.audioText: The NOTAM says this part of the taxiway is closed during this period, please verify.
cards.audioTextZh: 航行通告说部分滑行道在这期间关闭。请核实。

cards.audioText: We are stopping taxi. The boarding bridge is not at its designated position.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们停止（滑行）了。廊桥不在指定位置。

cards.audioText: Our cabin crew will direct all passengers to stay outside the runway after evacuation.
cards.audioTextZh: 撤离后我们的客舱机组将指导所有旅客待在跑道外。

cards.audioText: We have had a tail strike. Request to stop climb at 3000 feet and return for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已发生机尾擦地。请求3000英尺停止爬升并返场着陆。

cards.audioText: We have veered off the runway due asymmetric thrust. We are evacuating. Request emergency assistance.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于不对称推力，我们在跑道上突然转向偏出了跑道，正在撤离。申请紧急救助。

cards.audioText: We cannot get good climb profile due engine problems. Request maintain runway heading.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于发动机问题，我们不能得到很好的爬升剖面，申请保持跑道航向。

cards.audioText: The center of gravity is disturbed. We will relocate passengers prior to approach. Request holding.
cards.audioTextZh: 重心被干扰了。进近前我们将重新安排旅客。申请等待。

cards.audioText: My apologies for the deviation due the wrong altitude setting. Request further instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 抱歉由于错误的高度设定而偏离，申请进一步指令。

cards.audioText: My apologies for the level deviation. We were caught in a strong updraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 抱歉高度偏离了。我们遇到了强上升气流。

cards.audioText: We used too much speed brakes and penetrated our level. Did we cause any conflict?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们使用过大量的减速板而穿越了我们的高度。我们引起冲突了吗？

cards.audioText: We were not informed of a frequency change. I will now monitor your frequency.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们未得到频率改变的通知。我将现在监听你的频率。

cards.audioText: We have three serious and five minor injuries on board. Request ambulances on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们机上有三人重伤，五人轻伤。请求救护车到场。

cards.audioText: One passenger is having difficulty breathing. Request descent to a lower level to reduce cabin altitude.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名旅客呼吸困难。请求立即下降到较低高度以减小客舱高度。

cards.audioText: A stressed passenger attempted to open an emergency exit. Request airport security on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名闹情绪的旅客试图打开应急出口。申请机场保安到场。

cards.audioText: We have a hostage situation. Request stair vehicles on standby to disembark the passengers.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有一名人质。申请客梯车待命以便让旅客们下飞机。

cards.audioText: We have a passenger with a suspected heart attack. Request diversion to a suitable airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有名乘客疑似有心脏病。申请备降到合适机场。

cards.audioText: A pregnant passenger is in severe pain. Request priority landing and ambulance on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名孕妇承受剧痛。申请优先着陆和救护车到场。

cards.audioText: We have an 8-month old infant with head injuries. Request ambulance on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有个8个月大的婴儿头部受伤。申请救护车到场。

cards.audioText: We have a hijack situation on board. Can our destination airport provide armed intervention?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们被劫机了。我们的目的地机场能提供武装干涉吗？

cards.audioText: There is a stand-off in the cabin. Some of the hijackers are carrying blades.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱已陷于僵持状态。一些劫机犯拿着刀片。

cards.audioText: The air marshal and passengers have restrained five suspects. The situation is now under control.
cards.audioTextZh: 安全保安和旅客们已经制服了五名疑犯。局面得到了控制。

cards.audioText: Some explosives were discovered behind a panel near the back of the cabin.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱后部的一块面板后面发现一些爆炸物。

cards.audioText: A bomb has exploded and the cabin is full of smoke. Request emergency descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 炸弹已爆炸，客舱到处是烟雾。申请紧急下降。

cards.audioText: We are evacuating on the runway. Be advised the bomb is still on board.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们正在跑道上紧急撤离。请你告知相关人员炸弹还在飞机上。

cards.audioText: Our cargo manifest shows that there are 80 kilograms of lithium batteries on board.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们货物舱单表明机上有80千克的锂电池。

cards.audioText: We have a possible traffic conflict at 10 o’clock, converging with our flight path.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们可能在10点钟方位有冲突飞机，与我们的飞行线路会聚。

cards.audioText: Some of the cabin crew are injured. They were serving meals during the TCAS maneuver.
cards.audioTextZh: 部分客舱机组受伤了。TCAS机动时他们正在供餐。

cards.audioText: We veered off the runway. We are evacuating near the runway and rapid exit J5.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们偏出了跑道，正在撤离。我们的位置在跑道和快速脱离道口J5附近。

cards.audioText: The military aircraft has made an abrupt maneuver indicating we may continue on this heading.
cards.audioTextZh: 军用飞机已突然机动，表明我们可以继续保持此航向。

cards.audioText: Confirm we are being vectored to fly overhead the airport for right downwind.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实你会引导我们飞越机场上空然后做右三边。

cards.audioText: Sorry, there was a problem with my audio equipment. How do you read me now?
cards.audioTextZh: 抱歉，因为我们的音频设备有问题。现在你听我几个？

cards.audioText: Not ready for immediate takeoff due possible wake turbulence from departing heavy aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 没有准备好立即起飞，刚起飞的重型机可能有尾流。

cards.audioText: Are you banning us from entry because of our airline or our aircraft type?
cards.audioTextZh: 你禁止我们飞入是因为我们公司或我们的机型吗？
